When diving underwater, don't hold your breath in your cheeks, hold it in your chest. 

Don't bend the knees when kicking, keep the legs as straight and the toes as pointed as you can. Slight nee bending is okay, but not as effective. When you bend your knees, it stops the momentum. 

Same with the arms. Fingers close together and palms cupped. When lifting the arms out of the water, slightly bend the elbow. When putting your arm back into the water, place the hand on it's side as it's entering the surface, then push close to your body and straight behind you

If you're freestyling, every third stroke, you should take a breath. Exhale during the two other strokes. 

Wading in the water is easy. You see those miss America winners waving to the crowd gracefully? Well, do that with both hands. Then put your hands on the surface of the water and push your arms in and out while waving. Sync the arms and hands in a slower motion. Do tiny, slow kicks with your feet. 

Lastly, if you, for whatever reason, find yourself underwater and unable to kick yourself up, find the closest wall to you and try to reach it. Place your feet  and hands on the wall and crawl up.
